name: Grilled muong fish
summary: A fish about the size of a finger. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note says the flesh is soft, fragrant, and sweet, and that the usual plate is grilled over charcoal, then dipped in vinegar so the bones soften. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note places the kitchens at two spots, not in the Tuy Hòa market.
texture: Soft, fragrant, and sweet, about the size of a finger. A quick dip in vinegar softens the bones before the fish is plated.
howToEat: Grill it over charcoal. Dip it briefly in vinegar so the bones soften, then eat it with herbs and nước mắm nhỉ mixed with a little tamarind or peanut. The note also names gỏi, nhúng dấm, luộc, and chiên xù, and says the grill is the common plate. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Beside bàu Long Thăng, thị trấn La Hai, huyện Đồng Xuân, and at cầu Lò Gốm, xã An Thạch, huyện Tuy An. Those are the two clusters on the 29 December 2020 note. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca muong — grilled, then dipped in vinegar
seoDescription: Finger-sized fish grilled over charcoal at La Hai or cau Lo Gom. A dip in vinegar softens the bones. A price is Check on arrival.
